[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants near the Ritz-Carlton include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Navio (inside the Ritz-Carlton) - serves contemporary California cuisine with a focus on fresh seafood and steak.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. The Conservatory & Lounge (inside the Ritz-Carlton) - offers light bites, cocktails, and stunning views of the coastline.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Sam's Chowder House - a casual, waterfront spot serving fresh seafood, including their famous cioppino.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Barbara's Fishtrap - a seafood favorite with a cozy atmosphere and outdoor seating.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. La Costanera - offers a wide range of Mexican dishes, including seafood, steak, and vegetarian options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Cetrella Bistro & Café - French-inspired bistro with a focus on locally sourced ingredients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Half Moon Bay Brewing Company - a spot for craft beer enthusiasts with a menu of gastropub fare.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. It's Italia - family-owned restaurant serving pasta dishes, pizzas, and more.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reservations are highly recommended for these popular restaurants, especially on weekends or during peak season.
